dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light-to-dark gradient transitions; primary annuli located mid-dorsally exhibit crenulated, non-uniform outer perimeters with sharp pixel-intensity shifts.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, high-intensity light pixel clusters aggregated along the dorsal-cranial ridge and anterior to the mid-section, appearing as discrete, non-gradient localized maxima against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal annuli define an approximate scalene triangle, with a secondary linear vector of smaller clusters extending from the mid-section toward the dorsal-anterior limit.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized high-intensity circular patch visible on the posterior-lateral flank near the caudal transition, suggesting a distinct focal disruption of the standard pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained, high-frequency speckled mottling concentrated on the rostral and facial regions, exhibiting a significantly smaller cluster diameter than the macro-annuli observed on the torso.
